utility: Greedy disjoint expected-edge-weight sum after unlocking all required hard bundles. Exact exhaustive hard-bundle portfolio oracle; surrogate regret only.
scope: This surrogate assigns zero gain to soft questions, answered bundles and unrecoverable declined bundles. Such positive-cost actions are dominated by omission. Enumeration covers all remaining legal hard questions; it is not an oracle for a richer soft-information utility.
